desc:
In this part, Christensen uses the steel industry to help illustrate the process of Disruption, along with how it historically has nothing to do with stupid or bad management.

Clayton Christensen - one of the authors of The Innovator's Dilemma - giving a talk on what is disruptive innovation, and how small startup companies can end up beating incumbents.
